description: Return one miner's settlement record, rebuilt from individual sessions in the FLOP explorer, up to 90 days: settled, timeouts, settle_rate, independent_settle_rate (excluding agent wallets that opened over 25% of the window's sessions), distinct_agents, and series[] (ts, settled, timeouts, open, settle_rate per bucket). Open sessions are counted separately, never as a result. Errors if the miner has no sessions in the window. To compare all miners use flop_miner_ranking.

address.description: SS58 miner address, e.g. from flop_miner_ranking top[].address.

points.description: Maximum series points; the first and last snapshot are always kept.

window.description: Lookback in seconds (7 days by default, 90 days at most).

name: flop_miner_history
title: Settlement history of one miner
